description: TRUST measures a three-storey post-tensioned cross-laminated-timber rocking-wall structure under modal-identification and earthquake tests. Configurations vary self-centring components, energy-dissipation devices and selected inerter or wall-interface details. TDM files contain acceleration, displacement, force and strain measurements, with drawings, material information and sensor layouts. The stated embargo ends on 8 October 2026. The dataset is provided by IZIIS, Skopje through BED. BED assigns the experiment to 2025. The provider metadata identifies compressed archives, instrument or model files. Data access is restricted under an embargo ending 2026-10-08; the landing metadata remains public. Charges after release are not established. The stated licence is CC BY 4.0. The measurements support calibration or checking of infrastructure response models. Sampling resolution is not established here unless stated above; file-level quality remains unverified. No directly related catalogue record was confirmed.
